{{Infobox Musical
|name         = Spamilton
|subtitle     = An American Parody

A [[Chicago]] production of ''Spamilton'' opened at the Royal George Theatre on March 12, 2017. A production ran at the [[Kirk Douglas Theatre]] in [[Culver City, California|Culver City]] from November 5, 2017, to January 7, 2018, shortly before a national tour. US tours continued into 2024.
